name: The Woodland Protector
summary: In Shadowglen, Melithar Staghelm hears troubling whispers from the forest spirits. He asks you to seek Tarindrella, whose return to Teldrassil after many years away from Kalimdor’s woodlands hints that something is wrong.

sections.title: Whispers in the Glen
sections.body: Beneath Aldrassil’s boughs, Melithar Staghelm trains novices and listens to troubling omens from the woodland spirits. Tarindrella, a dryad known as a protector of the wild, has returned to Shadowglen after many years away from Kalimdor’s woodlands. Dryads rarely come without cause, so Melithar fears the natural order has fallen out of balance.

sections.title: Seeking the Dryad
sections.body: A Sentinel scouting report points newly awakened defenders southwest of Aldrassil, into the surrounding woods. There, you can find Tarindrella. Cenarius’s daughter has returned to address a taint affecting the barrow and nearby glades.

faq.answer: Melithar Staghelm, a night elf druid on Aldrassil’s lower platforms in Shadowglen, asks newly awakened adventurers for help.
You can find Tarindrella by the wooded paths of Shadowglen, in the forest southwest of Aldrassil.

Tarindrella is a dryad and one of Cenarius’s immortal daughters. Dryads are revered as woodland protectors, bound closely to the forest’s health, and rarely intervene directly unless nature faces a significant threat.

faq.q: Why is Melithar concerned about her return?
faq.answer: Tarindrella’s presence has been absent from Kalimdor’s forests for years. Her sudden return to Teldrassil’s newly grown boughs suggests something has gone wrong in the grove.
Speaking with Tarindrella completes the errand and brings her request for aid. She asks you to investigate corrupted plants and animals in Shadowglen.

faq.q: Is Melithar Staghelm related to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm?
faq.answer: Melithar shares the Staghelm surname with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, leader of the night elf druids in Darnassus, but no family tie between them is known. Melithar mentors fledglings in Shadowglen.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Aldrassil, you meet one of Cenarius’s daughters and take your first direct duty in preserving harmony in your young World Tree.
As a druid, you hold dryads in high esteem as kin in nature. Tarindrella’s presence calls you early to heed the balance of the Emerald Dream and the woods.
